name: priority:P0
description: Safety, correctness, integrity, security, architecture, or release blockers; work first when ready.

name: priority:P1
description: Production coverage, freshness, and material user value after applicable P0 gates.

name: priority:P2
description: Scale, convenience, optional sources, and future capabilities after the production path is stable.

name: status:planned
description: Scoped work awaiting dependency or readiness review.

name: status:ready
description: Dependencies and required owner inputs are satisfied; eligible for selection.

name: status:in-progress
description: The single mutable implementation issue currently owned by the continuous agent.

name: status:review
description: Implementation is finalized and awaiting validation, merge, or post-merge review.

name: status:blocked
description: Blocked by another repository prerequisite or failed dependency.

name: status:blocked-external
description: Blocked by third-party access, permission, contract, API, or other external condition.

name: status:needs-owner-input
description: A concrete repository-owner action is required and documented on the issue.

name: status:done
description: Merged and post-merge validation completed.

name: type:epic
description: Parent roadmap or multi-phase outcome tracker.

name: type:policy
description: Repository, product, evidence, or governance policy work.

name: type:architecture
description: Architecture decision, benchmark, or structural implementation.

name: type:workflow
description: GitHub Actions, automation, build, acquisition, or release workflow work.

name: type:data-source
description: Source discovery, acquisition, or adapter work.

name: type:data-quality
description: Freshness, validation, conflict, integrity, or quality work.

name: type:ios
description: Native iOS application implementation.

name: type:security
description: Security, privacy hardening, or incident-response work.

name: type:research
description: Bounded research with an explicit decision or implementation outcome.

name: type:feature
description: User-visible or product capability implementation.

name: area:catalog
description: Catalog compilation, content, manifest, or release area.

name: area:sources
description: External and open-data source acquisition and provenance area.

name: area:licensing
description: Data/source rights metadata and release compliance area.

name: area:workflows
description: GitHub Actions and repository automation area.

name: area:sqlite
description: SQLite schema, compiler, query, size, and performance area.

name: area:halal-methodology
description: Ingredient analysis, evidence rules, review, and assessment area.

name: area:ios
description: iOS application, SwiftUI, camera, and local-runtime area.

name: area:submissions
description: Missing-product and correction evidence submission area.

name: area:privacy
description: Privacy, consent, retention, and personal-data area.

name: area:security
description: Workflow, parser, file, secret, and application security area.

name: area:retailer
description: Retailer identity, assortment, observation, and official-feed area.

name: area:certification
description: Halal certifier, certificate, scope, validity, and matching area.

name: area:observability
description: Coverage, freshness, health, operational reporting, and incidents area.

name: needs:owner-action
description: Contains a specific repository-owner action; pair with the appropriate status label.
